source: Saved A5 exact pre-dopamine checkpoint, update geometry, and motor-spike/readout traces; A6 first-note cooldown result. No new historical training replay.
selection_evidence: In the A5 real-full first note, 9 motor spikes were in the 20-ms readout window before the first 372383000-us on-threshold crossing; motor cells 94,95,96 spiked at that tick and raised the count to 12 across threshold 10. The four 300-ms relay sources 48,49,50,51 each connect to these three cells. Selection uses target identities and the saved crossing spike batch, not any new probe score.
structural_split: Partition the 48 selected 300-ms relay->motor edges by postsynaptic motor targets: target cohort {94,95,96} (12 edges; source IDs 48-51) versus the other nine 300-ms motor targets 97-105 (36 edges). Intervene only on the first cohort. Predeclared selected sparse edge slots: 136,137,138,148,149,150,160,161,162,172,173,174.
intervention: From the same exact pre-dopamine checkpoint, apply the full real RPE through production plasticity, then restore only the 12 selected cohort weights to their pre-update values. All other 468 selected weights, full-update clipping on them, and all nonweight state remain identical to the real-full branch. Do not renormalize or redistribute.
frozen_probe: Use the exact existing A5 32-note relative-time/cue-gain panel with plasticity and exploration disabled. Save all motor-spike tick batches, threshold crossings, decisions, DOWN actions, event errors and score summaries. The first note is primary; later notes are secondary because action changes may affect subsequent closed-loop state.
primary_endpoint: Time in integer microseconds of the first upward motor on-threshold crossing. Existing no-update is 372456000 us and real-full is 372383000 us. A later crossing than full, by at least one 1000-us tick, is a causal contribution toward the no-update timing in this selected state. Report the exact movement and fraction of the 73000-us baseline separation; do not infer sufficiency of the omitted cohort. If crossing is unchanged, no upstream timing contribution is detected under this omission. If crossing is earlier, absent, or accompanied by a changed first action pattern, report a nonlinear or opposing effect without forcing a rescue claim.
secondary_endpoints: motor-spike counts in the 20-ms readout window immediately before and at first crossing
scope_limit: Synthetic Branch A only. Exactly one structurally defined 300-ms omission; no score-ranked masks, parameter tuning, production-rule change, extra training, or generalization beyond the selected checkpoint.
